Explain why simple diffusion is not sufficient to account for the passage of all of the
dissolved minerals into the cells of water plants.

options.A: Simple diffusion can only transport minerals when they are bound to oxygen molecules
options.B: Simple diffusion cannot occur against a concentration gradient
options.C: Simple diffusion requires specific carrier proteins for each mineral
options.D: Simple diffusion only works for organic compounds, not inorganic minerals
options.E: Simple diffusion can transport minerals in any concentration

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - Simple diffusion cannot occur against a concentration gradient

questions.stem_text:
Which of the following is a second messenger that stimulates release of calcium ions into
the cytoplasm?
All of the following statements are true EXCEPT

options.B: growth hormone stimulates cell division and protein synthesis
options.C: epinephrine increases blood sugar levels and heart rate
options.D: thyroxine increases the rate of metabolism
options.E: vasopressin stimulates water reabsorption in the kidney

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - insulin decreases storage of glycogen

questions.stem_text:
One group of compounds that may become quite important in birth control is the
prostaglandins. What are the advantages of prostaglandins in birth control?

options.A: Prostaglandins are used to enhance mood and have no effect on birth control.
options.B: Prostaglandins increase fertility by promoting ovulation.
options.C: Prostaglandins are able to prevent pregnancy by altering the DNA of the sperm and egg.
options.D: Prostaglandins are known to mediate hormonal action
options.E: Prostaglandins are non-hormonal, reducing the risk of hormonal side effects.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Prostaglandins are used to enhance mood and have no effect on birth control.
